message: The good news is that the design is complete. The emulation found no architecture failures: every part is connected, and sign-in, user isolation, context limits and escalation are all modelled. All 8 blockers have the same cause. The product has no generator yet for an Azure chat app with Entra, App Service, Cosmos DB, Azure OpenAI, Content Safety and Service Bus, and none of the supported contracts can produce it without shrinking the scope. Changing the diagram won't fix this. It needs product engineering work: a native Azure generator, with this artifact (e96367dc…, revision 2) as the reproducer. So I'm leaving the diagram unchanged. We can still settle the missing decisions in the meantime. Which country does the synthetic conversation data need to stay in, for example "EU only" or "no restriction for synthetic data"? That decides which Azure regions we can consider for the model and Cosmos DB.
